title: Error resolving plugin [id: 'com.facebook.react.settings']
body:
### Minimal reproducible example

https://github.com/reporter/SampleExpo

### What platform(s) does this occur on?

Android

### Where did you reproduce the issue?

in a development build

### Summary

I created a simple Expo Project using `npx create-expo-app@latest --template blank-typescript`, I need to write native android code so I did following

`npx expo install expo-dev-client`

`npx expo run:android`

`npx create-expo-module@latest --local`

I have the necessary Android Setup on my Mac like Android Studio, Java etc

When I open the android folder in Android Studio I get following error during gradle sync. I have not written a single line of code

Alright I found a "fix" scouring through the web.
taken from: https://seung-yo.tistory.com/entry/RN-Error-resolving-plugin-id-comfacebookreactsettings-%EC%98%A4%EB%A5%98-%ED%95%B4%EA%B2%B0

it essentially boils down to these steps:
`npm install`

This uninstall + install seems to fix that weird `com.facebook.react.settings` issue
`npm uninstall react-native`
`npm install react-native`

`cd android`
`./gradlew clean`

EDIT: this causes newer errors with `react-native-gesture-handler` & `react-native-webview`, but you can simply do the same procedure to fix it
`npm uninstall react-native-gesture-handler react-native-webview`
`npm install react-native-gesture-handler react-native-webview` 


My guess as to why simply nuking node_modules doesnt work, is probably due to the global npm cache.
